title: DanaRS "Wrong Pump Password" despite correct password... limited functionality.
symptom: After installing AAPS 2.8.2, the app connects to the DanaRS pump and shows BG value, but gives error 'Wrong Pump Password', leading to limited functionality: 'Insulin', 'Carbs', and 'Calculator' functions are not showing up, only 'CGM' is visible. The password in the pump (default 0000) and in AAPS settings match, yet the error persists.
cause: The user thought they were changing the pump password but actually failed to correctly input the old password, because the Dana pump gives no error message if the wrong old password is entered. Thus the password was not actually changed on the pump.
fix: Correctly change the pump password by entering the old password first, then set a new one, and put that new password into AAPS settings.
evidence_quote: The issue was that I thought I was changing the password in the pump, when in fact I just failed to correctly input the old password, because Dana gives no error message if you put in the wrong one.
